kreno_fpatcher.config.title: Kreno Config
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.compress.com: The compression level for packets, between 1-9.
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.fix.issues12: Run bandwidth statistics on sync thread, which is closer to Vanilla behaviour.
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.mixin.textFi: Replace text filter thread with virtual thread
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.mixin.utilVT: Replace download thread with virtual thread
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.mixin.client: Enable new encryption optimisations on the client side
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.mixin.server: Skips sending movement packets if the entity hasn't moved, and downgrades position+rotation packets to just rotation if the entity only turned.
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.mixin.packet: Halves concurrent queue operations when draining queued packets on the main thread.
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.mixin.partic: Reduces some potentially useless particle packets. This configuration only takes effect on the server side.
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.mixin.tracke: Optimises entity packet broadcasting and integrates with server-side entity culling to reduce network overhead.
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.netty.alloca: Change Netty's default 16MiB memory allocation to 4MiB, as Minecraft has a 2MiB packet size limit.
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.netty.happyE: Enable Happy Eyeballs (RFC 8305) for client connections to race IPv6 and IPv4. May cause some servers (like Velocity) to temporarily refuse connections.
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.gui.oreui.de: Replace Minecraft style KReno UI with a newly designed OreUI
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.culling.enti: Smart entity culling on server side
kreno_fpatcher.config.entry.culling.part: Smart particle culling on server side
